definition: Assessor hours spent on one mandatory control-claim assessment, including evidence review and workpaper, excluding technical review
formula: median and inter-quartile range of assessorHours

definition: Host staff hours to locate, prepare and provide evidence for one request row
formula: sum(hostHours) / count(rows with receiptStatus RECEIVED, PARTIAL or SUBSTITUTED)
dataSource: evidence request tracking columns (AIDCF-PIL-003 section 5): hostHours

definition: Share of host-facing mandatory request rows fulfilled, and fulfilled by the due date
formula: fulfilled = rows RECEIVED or SUBSTITUTED with approved alternative / rows with al3Use MANDATORY or MANDATORY_EXISTING_RECORDS_ONLY; on time = fulfilled with receivedDate <= dueDate / same denominator
dataSource: evidence request tracking columns (AIDCF-PIL-003 section 5): receiptStatus; receivedDate; dueDate

definition: Share of AVAILABILITY_ONLY rows for which the item exists
formula: rows EXISTS / rows AVAILABILITY_ONLY
dataSource: evidence request tracking columns (AIDCF-PIL-003 section 5): receiptStatus

definition: Share of mandatory control-claims whose result is UNKNOWN
formula: count(primaryResult = UNKNOWN) / (mandatory control-claims - NOT_APPLICABLE)
breakdown: unknownType U1-U10; unknownSeverity US1-US5; domain; gate

definition: Share of mandatory control-claims left NOT_ASSESSED, with cause
formula: count(primaryResult = NOT_ASSESSED) / (mandatory control-claims - NOT_APPLICABLE)

definition: Distribution of achieved package sufficiency against the applicable floor
formula: count by sufficiencyAchieved S0-S5; count below floor
breakdown: claimType; requestBasis of the floor (profile or pattern)

definition: Agreement between primary and blind second assessor on the double-assessment sample
formula: raw agreement = matching results / sampled items; full contingency table; Cohen's kappa (Cohen, 1960) with n

definition: Agreement between the lead assessor's Gate Results and an independent re-derivation from the same reviewed control results and criteria
formula: matching Gate Results / evaluated gates (9)

definition: Classification of every control-result or Gate Result disagreement
formula: count by cause: criterion ambiguity; evidence interpretation; scope or boundary; vocabulary; competence; recording error

definition: Differences between two independent first drafts of the capability profile and boundary before reconciliation
formula: count of differing items (Service Outcomes; tolerances; boundary inclusions and exclusions; dependencies) / union of items

definition: Share of material statements in the Decision Recommendation with a complete trace to control assessments, Gate Results, Findings, UNKNOWN Records and Evidence Objects (AMH-REQ-017)
formula: statements with complete trace / material statements

definition: Problems practitioners met in using the method, templates or tools
formula: count of AIDCF-PIL-005 items with category USABILITY

definition: Defects found in control requirements, assessment criteria, gate criteria, evidence profiles, gate mappings, vocabularies or templates
formula: count of AIDCF-PIL-005 items with a DEFECT_ category

definition: Material findings with no suitable control in the 360-control registry
formula: count of WP-15 Findings flagged orphan

definition: Dependencies recorded under CG-03 that were absent from the host's own records before the pilot
formula: count of dependencies in WP-03 baseline not present in host records at SG1
breakdown: dependency type (upstream; shared source; shared route; utility; telecom; cloud and service; sub-tier; recovery)
dataSource: WP-03; CG-03 workbook; host records at SG1

definition: Cases where the reported band for a domain or outcome is B4 or B5 while a relevant gate is FAIL or UNKNOWN, or the band is B1 or B2 while relevant gates PASS
formula: count of divergent domain-outcome pairs

definition: Named decision user's ratings of statements U1-U5 and comparison U6
formula: ratings reported individually with reasons; not aggregated

measure: Effort and elapsed time against plan
definition: Actual elapsed weeks and person-days per phase against the AIDCF-PIL-001 section 8.2 planning assumptions
formula: actual; planned range; within range yes or no

definition: Cases where applying the AIDCF standards required an interpretation (for example sufficiency floor for shallower claim types; coverage denominator; test-dependent gate criteria at AL3)
formula: count, each with the interpretation used and the result it affected
